display_long_description:
Are you tired of subscription workout apps? then get this one for free.

Color Fit is A mixed reality workout experience that gets your whole body moving. Break boxes using hand tracking while encouraging full-body motion to warm up your muscles. Ideal for morning exercise. The physics-based gameplay makes it surprisingly addictive.

Features:

- Room-scale mixed reality – No motion sickness, no hitting walls, and no tripping over kids or pets.

- Hand tracking – No controllers, and no excuse for breaking your TV.

- Dynamic shadows on virtual objects – The cubes feel like they truly exist in your room.

- Full-body movement – You’ll feel every stretch (and maybe hear a few cracks).

- Built with purpose – I made this app to help relieve my back pain, hopefully, it helps with yours too.

- Early access – Expect major updates and improvements over time.

Please join my discord to shape this app based on your feedback. I need you! https://discord.gg/ZGAHEuA
